projectDescription: A control plane for autonomous AI research that queues ideas, gates worker dispatch, supervises local AI runs, preserves evidence, and packages AI-generated research artifacts with provenance.
keyFeatures: Queue state management with idempotent APIs
Worker-gate execution: process-tree tracking and CPU/GPU quiet-window telemetry
Worker preflight health checks before dispatching agent runs
Single-lane GPU safety to prevent overlapping heavy workloads
Evidence sync from worker to control VM before artifact generation
AI-generated research artifact writer with claim ledger and provenance
Quality gates scanning for placeholder citations and missing evidence
Live operations dashboard with project queue, paper queue, and run board
Pushover alerts for queue hangs and stoppages
publicApiSurface: GET /control/api/status — dispatch safety and queue state
GET /control/api/queue-health — queue health with worker freshness
GET /control/api/queues/{queue} — paginated queue rows (active, queued, blocked, paused)
POST /control/api/paper-reviews/{id}/rewrite-draft — rewrite paper with AI model
POST /dispatch — dispatch agent run to worker
GET /enoch-core/health — enoch-core mode and DB status
